sources.acs: U.S. Census Bureau, American Community Survey ACS 5-year 2020-2024, table-based summary files
sources.gazetteer: U.S. Census Bureau, 2024 Gazetteer Files, counties
sources.medsl: MIT Election Data and Science Lab, County Presidential Election Returns 2000-2024, Harvard Dataverse doi:10.7910/DVN/VOQCHQ, version 20.0 (CC0 1.0)

county_fips.description: 2024 county FIPS code (Connecticut planning regions 09110 to 09190)

county.description: County name, from the 2024 boundary file

median_hh_income.description: Median household income in the past 12 months (B19013_001)

pct_bachelors_plus.description: Share of people 25 and over with a bachelor's, master's, professional or doctoral degree (B15003_022 to _025 over B15003_001)

dem_share_2p_2016.description: Democratic share of the two-party presidential vote, 2016

margin_dr_2016.description: (Democratic - Republican) / total presidential votes, 2016; the sign convention of data-center-map's county_votes.json

geo_basis_2016.description: county: the county's own 2016 returns; state: statewide values (Alaska and Connecticut); blank: no returns
